x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: With the changes in Jakarta release, a new column has been added to resource_event_color table named "type" of type choice list pointing to the choices of category column in time_card table. This fix script will copy the values of the column event_type to type if the value of event_type is a valid choice for the column type
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Copy event types in resource_event_color
